title: HTML Template Split (STAGE) — extract 15 page sections to platform/pages/<id>.html (byte-exact, preserved inline) + Upg.shards IIFE (29th top-level Upg.* namespace, ~180 JS lines) with frozen surface (list/loadShard/preloadAll/audit/verify/mountShard/discipline) + sw.js v3 precache rewrite (added 6 CSS shards from W23 P3 + 15 page shards from this phase + dedicated SHARD_CACHE bucket with cache-first strategy on /pages/*.html paths + version bump atelier-v16-2026-05 → devotio-v3-w23-p4-2026-05) + 15 data-shard-id annotations on inline <section class="page"> opening tags + 12-line Phase 4 discipline comment block before #rit-entry-portal in index.html + per-shard 7-line banner pointing back to source line range. Strategy: STAGE-AND-REPLACE conservative — Phase 4 stages the architecture without thinning the shell because navigateTo (app.js line 153-169) captures document.querySelectorAll('.page') as a STATIC NodeList at IIFE init; live querying is a Phase 5 (JS ESM) concern. The actual swap is therefore safe to defer: Upg.shards.mountShard() refuses while inline copy is present (requires {force:true} override) so accidental calls cannot double-mount. file:// users keep working because loadShard catches network failures silently and the inline copy still renders. Sacred preserved 100% (15 page sections inline still rendering, +1 in discipline comment quote = 16 grep hit / 391 qcalc inline + 391 qcalc in shards = exact 1:1 byte-equivalence proven via balance counter / 28 → 29 Upg.* APIs (added Upg.shards) / 0 google fonts / 0 CDN / 0 framework / W12 P2 Linen-Bone + W21 P2 Mihrab themes untouched / W22 entry portal/halo/threshold/inkpot/atmosphere/aura preserved / W23 P3 CSS shatter chain (tokens/base/utilities/chrome/pages/motion) intact / Phase 1-2 IIFEs (Upg.layer with auditImportant) untouched). Branch: worker-23-devotio-p4 (1 commit so far). Cleanup: scripts/split-html.mjs deleted post-extraction (one-shot, splitter logic remains in git history under deletion). 18 files changed, 31487 insertions, 17 deletions. Net structural delta: scaffolds for Phase 5 finalization (which migrates JS to ESM, switches navigateTo to live queries, then performs the actual inline → shard cutover with zero rework on the shard files since they are already byte-exact).
